义项: 动词 将…概念化；构思（conceptualize time / a problem）
[辨析] conceptualize（形成概念）≠ conceptualise（英式拼写）
搭配说明: conceptualization — n. 概念化——真题名词形
conceptual — adj. 概念上的
conceptualize ≠ conceptualize as — 真题直接接宾语：conceptualize time

例句.英文: Rafael Núnez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time.
例句.中文: Rafael Núnez 及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚原住民群体尤普诺人如何概念化时间。

例句.英文: In an anthropology paper, a student claims that the tendency toward ego-based conceptualizations of time is universal.
例句.中文: 在一篇人类学论文中，一位学生主张：以自我为参照的时间概念倾向具有普世性。

义项: 动词 躲过、避开（追捕、把握）
动词 (引申义) 难倒、为……所不能理解：问题/答案「躲着」人（熟词僻义，SAT 常考）
[构词] 拉丁 e-（向外）+ ludere（玩）→「玩着脱身」
搭配说明: elusive — adj. 难以捉摸的（2100 卷：renders the final homecoming elusive「使最终归乡难以企及」）
allude — v. 提及、暗指（拼形易混）
elusion — n. 逃避

例句.英文: A conclusive demonstration of the logical certainty of the Marden tameness conjecture, posed in 1974, ______ mathematicians until Ian Agol presented a proof of the conjecture in 2004.（本题正确选项即 eluded）
例句.中文: 关于 1974 年提出的「马尔登驯服猜想」逻辑必然性的确凿证明，一直难倒（躲过）数学家们——直到 2004 年伊恩·阿戈尔才给出证明。

义项: 形容词 conducive to 有助于…发生、为…提供有利条件的
[构词] conduce v. 导致 / 有助于 → conducive adj.；通常作表语或后置定语，conditions conducive to X 是科学阅读固定搭配

例句.英文: Some astrobiologists have proposed that brine—water with a concentration of dissolved solids of more than 3.5%—may present conditions conducive to the evolution of life on extraterrestrial bodies.
例句.原书高亮: present conditions conducive to the evolution
例句.中文: 一些天体生物学家提出，卤水——即溶解固体浓度超过 3.5% 的水——可能为地外天体上生命的演化提供有利条件。

义项: 名词 推测；猜测（conjectures about new situations）
[辨析] conjecture（无充分证据的推测）≠ inference（有依据的推断）
搭配说明: conjectural — adj. 推测性的
conjecture ≠ conjecture that — 真题作 pondering conjectures about 琢磨着各种猜想
speculation / surmise — n. 推测 / n. 臆测——近义

例句.英文: ​​​​​​​ though it seemed to many mathematicians, the honeycomb conjecture, posited in the first century BCE, eventually yielded to the efforts of Thomas C.
例句.中文: 我平静地继续着一天的活计；但不时有模糊的念头掠过脑海，想着我该离开桑菲尔德的理由，还忍不住起草广告、琢磨着关于各种新职位的猜想。

义项: 名词 词语所附带的评价或情感色彩，与 denotation 字面义相对（its negative connotation）
名词 符号、姿态或行为所暗示的意味

例句.英文: Thus, Apichatpong's description of his films is not self-deprecation; rather, his work invites sleep and thereby strips the description of its negative connotation.
例句.中文: 因此，阿彼察邦对自己影片的描述并非自贬；相反，他的作品引人入睡，从而剥离了这一说法原本的负面含义。

义项: 动词 用独立证据支持某一说法或研究结论（corroborate a claim）
动词 另一项研究得出相同结果，与前者互相印证
动词 古义：使论点或信念更加牢固

例句.英文: Prabuddha De et al. found that a recommender system (RS)—an algorithm that generates personalized product suggestions for online shoppers—impacted consumer behavior and increased sales, a result that was corroborated by Dokyun Lee and Kartik Hosanagar.
例句.原书高亮: that was corroborated by Dokyun Lee
例句.中文: Prabuddha De 等人发现，推荐系统（一种为网购者生成个性化商品建议的算法）会影响消费者行为并提升销售额，这一结果得到了 Dokyun Lee 与 Kartik Hosanagar 的佐证。

例句.英文: D ensure that interpretations attributing an environmental ethic to the riddles can be corroborated by attitudes toward reflected in other documents from the period.

义项: 名词 密码学；加密技术（digital cryptography）
[构词] crypto-（隐藏）+ -graphy（写）
搭配说明: cryptology / cryptologist — n. 密码学（广义） / n. 密码学家
cryptic / encrypt — adj. 隐晦的 / v. 加密
cryptography ≠ cryptography of — 真题作 teaches digital cryptography 教授数字密码学

例句.英文: In this way, Feinstein and others like her helped make it possible for more women—such as Anna Lysyanskaya, who currently works in and teaches digital cryptography—to enter the field of cryptology.
例句.中文: 就这样，范斯坦和她那样的人让更多女性得以进入密码学领域——比如目前在数字密码学领域工作并任教的 Anna Lysyanskaya。

例句.英文: In this way, Driscoll and others like her helped make it possible for more women—such as Shafi Goldwasser, who currently works in and teaches digital cryptography—to enter the field of cryptology.

义项: 动词 使茫然；使眩晕（be dazed by / after）
名词 迷乱状态：in a daze
搭配说明: dazed — adj. 茫然的；眩晕的——真题以此形出现
dazzle — v. 使目眩——形近异义
daze ≠ dazed and confused — 真题只取「发懵」义

例句.英文: The Mole is dazed after briefly meeting a stranger while traveling with a friend. (The) Mole stood still a moment, held in thought.
例句.原书高亮: The Mole is dazed after briefly meeting a stranger
例句.中文: 鼹鼠在和朋友同行时短暂遇见一个陌生人后有些发懵。鼹鼠站着愣了一会儿，陷入沉思。

例句.英文: During the whole process of getting started, [Pollyanna] had kept up an uninterrupted stream of comments and questions, until the somewhat dazed Nancy found herself quite out of breath trying to keep up with her.

义项: 形容词 （态度）矛盾的：两种对立情感并存、摇摆不定
[构词] ambi-（两边）+ val（价值）+ -ent →「两头都有价值」
搭配说明: ambivalence — n. 矛盾心理（真题 6 次中 3 次为此名词形）
ambivalently — adv. 矛盾地
同根 val- — ambiguous adj. 模棱两可的（易混——但侧重「含义不明」而非「情感两难」）

例句.英文: The poem highlights an ambivalence toward poetry as the speaker acknowledges its merits while also expressing a sense of displeasure.
例句.中文: 这首诗凸显了说话者对诗歌的矛盾态度：一方面承认诗歌的价值，一方面又流露出不悦之感。（诗歌主旨题：需选出体现这种矛盾心理的诗行）

义项: 动词 使衰弱；使虚弱（a debilitating injury / illness）
动词 (引申义) 削弱（机构、经济等的）力量
搭配说明: debilitating — adj. 使人衰弱的——真题以此形出现
debility / debilitation — n. 衰弱
debilitate ≠ debilitated — 后者是过去分词 / 形容词
enervate / incapacitate — v. 使无力 / v. 使丧失能力——近义

例句.英文: In the play, Odysseus and Neoptolemus must retrieve Philoctetes—a master archer who is believed necessary for the Greeks to win the Trojan War—from a cave on the deserted island of Lemnos where Odysseus and others had abandoned him with a debilitating injury earlier in the war.
例句.中文: 剧中，奥德修斯与涅俄普托勒摩斯必须把菲罗克忒忒斯——一位被认为对希腊人赢得特洛伊战争不可或缺的神射手——从利姆诺斯荒岛的洞穴里带回；战争早期，奥德修斯等人正是把他连同那处使人衰弱的伤口遗弃在了那里。

义项: 名词 （法律、公文用语）死亡；deceased adj. 已故的 / n. 死者
名词 probate inventories 遗嘱认证清单，即详尽记录死者财物的法律文书；别与 disease 混淆

例句.英文: Support for the argument that a “consumer revolution,” in which possession of consumer goods among an increasingly wide range of socioeconomic groups surged despite only marginal wage growth, occurred in England between 1600 and 1750 has largely hinged on scholars’ analyses of probate inventories (detailed legal records of deceased persons’ possessions).
例句.中文: 「1600 至 1750 年间英格兰发生过一场消费革命」——即尽管工资仅微幅增长，消费品却在社会经济阶层中大幅普及——这一论点，其依据主要来自学者对遗嘱认证清单（详细记录已故者财产的法律文书）的分析。

义项: 名词 减压；卸压（release gas by decompression）
名词 （潜水员的）减压（ decompression sickness 减压病）
搭配说明: decompress / compress — v. 减压 / v. 压缩——真题两形同现
compression — n. 压缩——反义，真题科技类高频
pressure-temperature swing adsorption — 变温变压吸附（PTSA）——真题术语

例句.英文: They compared ALF's hydrogen volumetric capacity when using a pressure- temperature swing adsorption (PTSA) process—in which gas is subjected to high pressure and low temperature, allowing its adsorption for storage, and is released by decompression and heating (to 5 bar and 296 K, respectively, in Evans et al.'s study)—to the volumetric capacity of tanks using a standard hydrogen-compression process under 100 bar and 25 bar of pressure and various minimum temperatures.
例句.中文: 他们比较了 ALF 在采用变温变压吸附（PTSA）工艺时的氢气体积容量——该工艺把气体置于高压低温下使其吸附储存，再通过减压与升温（在 Evans 等人的研究中分别为 5 bar 与 296 K）把气体释放出来——以及采用 100 bar、25 bar 标准压缩工艺与不同最低温度的储罐的体积容量。

义项: 动词 使落叶；摘除…的叶子（defoliate a plant）
动词 （牲畜）啃光叶片——真题生态类语境
搭配说明: defoliation — n. 落叶；去叶
foliage / foliate — n. 叶丛 / adj. 有叶的——同根 foli-（叶）
defoliate ≠ deforest — 后者是「砍伐森林」

例句.英文: Because they selectively defoliate certain preferred plant species, grazing livestock are a potential source of ecosystem disturbance.
例句.原书高亮: selectively defoliate certain preferred plant species
例句.中文: 由于放牧牲畜会有选择地啃光某些偏好的植物种类的叶片，它们构成了生态系统扰动的一个潜在来源。

义项: 形容词 （感情）外露的；过分表露的（a demonstrative person）
形容词 指示的：demonstrative pronoun 指示代词——同形异义
[辨析] demonstrative（感情外露）≠ demonstrable（可证明的）
搭配说明: demonstrate / demonstration — v. 展示；论证 / n. 展示；示威
demonstratively — adv. 外露地
reserved / undemonstrative — adj. 含蓄的 / adj. 不露声色的——反义

例句.英文: Chance travellers might praise or pet him; but he was cold under it all, and from a too demonstrative man he would get up and walk away.
例句.中文: 偶然路过的旅人也许会夸他、摸摸他；可他对这一切都很冷淡，遇到一个感情过于外露的人，他便起身走开。

义项: 形容词 表面的、肤浅的：只触及表层、不深入
[构词] super-（上面）+ fic（面、做）→「只做表面」
搭配说明: superficially — adv. 浅表地（2093 卷真题词形）
superfluous — adj. 多余的（词表已收录——拼形近、义不同，注意区分）
surface — n. 表面（同根）

例句.英文: Her other major novels consist mainly of scenes of everyday life and describe their characters' interior states in great detail, whereas Orlando propels itself through a series of fantastical events and considers its characters' psychology more superficially.
例句.中文: 她的其他主要小说大多由日常生活场景构成，对人物内心状态的刻画细致入微；而《奥兰多》则由一连串奇幻事件推进，对人物心理的处理较为浮光掠影。

义项: 形容词 完全没有…的（destitute of：毫无…）——书面语
形容词 (引申义) 赤贫的；一无所有的（the destitute 穷人）
搭配说明: destitution — n. 赤贫；匮乏
destitute ≠ destitute of — 真题取「缺乏」义，不是「贫穷」义
devoid of / bereft of — adj. 全无…的——近义

例句.英文: The knowledge, communicated by the historian and biographer, is analogous to that which we acquire of a country by the map,—minute, perhaps, and accurate, and available for all necessary purposes, but cold and naked, and wholly destitute of the mimic charm produced by landscape painting.
例句.原书高亮: wholly destitute of the mimic charm
例句.中文: 历史学家与传记作者所传达的知识，类似于我们通过地图获得的对一国的了解——或许细致而准确，足以应付一切必要用途，却是冰冷而赤裸的，全无风景画所带来的那种拟真的魅力。

义项: 名词 哲学立场：一切结果都由先前条件必然决定，自由意志只是错觉
名词 causal determinism 强调因果链条的必然性；真题常与 incompatible 搭配
名词 认为技术或环境单向塑造社会文化的理论

例句.英文: Because they accommodate multiple potential outcomes, such models may seem incompatible with causal determinism—the view that particular outcomes are inevitable given certain preconditions.
例句.中文: 由于这类模型容纳多种可能结果，它们似乎与因果决定论不相容——决定论认为，给定某些前提条件，特定结果就是不可避免的。

义项: 动词 使有尊严；使显得庄重（dignify a subject / a name）
动词 (引申义) 美化；给…抬高身价（常用于否定：dignify with a reply）
搭配说明: dignity / dignified — n. 尊严 / adj. 庄严的——真题以 dignified 出现
dignitary — n. 显要人物
dignify ≠ indignant — 形近异义：后者是「愤慨的」

例句.英文: He determined to pursue the career of ornithologist; there was something so dignified and withal scientific about a science that called the sparrow Passer domesticus and the robin Erithacus rubecula.
例句.原书高亮: something so dignified and withal scientific
例句.中文: 他决意以鸟类学家为业；一门把麻雀叫作 Passer domesticus、把知更鸟叫作 Erithacus rubecula 的学问，是那样庄重而同时又那样科学。

义项: 形容词 迥然不同的； disparate fields / sources（强调彼此之间缺乏关联）
[辨析] disparate（性质悬殊）≠ desperate（绝望的）——SAT 高频形近陷阱
搭配说明: disparity — n. 悬殊；差异（真题社科类高频）
disparate ≠ separate — 后者只是「分开的」
disparately — adv. 各不相同地

例句.英文: Irrational juxtaposition or disparate elements is a central aspect of surrealist collage. .
例句.中文: 非理性并置或迥异元素的组合，是超现实主义拼贴的核心面向。

例句.英文: Enacted in societies as disparate as early modern France and Tokugawa Japan, sumptuary laws—restrictions on personal spending on luxury—often focused on matters of dress, such as the specific colors allowed for different social classes.

义项: 动词 使满足、使饱足（欲望、胃口）：充分供给到不再渴求
[构词] 拉丁 satis「足量」——satisfy、saturate 同源
搭配说明: insatiable — adj. 无法满足的、贪得无厌的（SAT 高频衍生词）
satiation — n. 满足
近义 — satisfy / sate（sate 即其缩短形）

例句.英文: From sculptures like Miró's Chicago by Joan Miró, found at Brunswick Plaza, to street art like Kristen Kula's mural Tornado on East 11th Street, Chicago offers an array of works to ____ the tastes of art lovers.（本题正确选项即 satiate）
例句.中文: 从布伦瑞克广场米罗的雕塑《芝加哥》，到东 11 街克里斯滕·库拉的壁画《龙卷风》，芝加哥提供了琳琅满目的作品，足以满足艺术爱好者的品味。（阅读完形题，空格正确答案为 B. satiate）

义项: 名词 意见分歧；纷争（dissension between the states / within a group）
[辨析] dissension（内部的意见不合）≠ dissent（持异议，可作动词）
搭配说明: dissent / dissenter — n./v. 异议 / n. 持异议者
dissension ≠ dissention — 标准拼写为 -sion
discord / strife — n. 不和 / n. 争斗——近义

例句.英文: Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No.6, “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States," was surely penned by Hamilton, No.52, "The House of Representatives," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
例句.原书高亮: Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States
例句.中文: 尽管大部分单篇文章的作者身份确定，仍有少数存疑：例如第6篇《论各州之间纷争之危险》肯定出自汉密尔顿之手，而第52篇《众议院》则可能由汉密尔顿或麦迪逊所写。

义项: 名词 废弃；不再使用（fall into disuse）
[构词] dis-（取消）+ use
搭配说明: disuse ≠ misuse / abuse — 误用 / 滥用——形近异义
obsolescence — n. 过时、淘汰——近义
fall into disuse — 固定搭配：逐渐被弃用

例句.英文: Episodes in which technologies fall into disuse after a period of adoption, as occurred with the loss of bow-and-arrow technology in northern Europe during the late Paleolithic, are informative for understanding the factors shaping technological development in ancient societies.
例句.原书高亮: technologies fall into disuse after a period of adoption
例句.中文: 技术在被采用一段时间后又遭废弃的情形——例如旧石器时代晚期北欧弓箭技术的流失——有助于我们理解古代社会中塑造技术发展的种种因素。

例句.英文: It is one of more than 2,000 disused railroad corridors in the US that have been converted into public trails since the 1960s..
例句.中文: 这是美国 1960 年代以来 2,000 多条废弃铁路走廊改建为公共步道的一例。

义项: 名词 观点、数据、路径之间的背离（divergence of opinion）
名词 生物学：同一祖先谱系分化为不同支系
名词 数学 / 物理：与标准值或平衡态的偏离量

例句.英文: Many have attributed this divergence to the nearly 3,500‑mile‑long “dingo fence,” a barrier installed to prevent access to livestock, that created a division of Australia into large southeast and northwest sections around 150 years ago.
例句.原书高亮: attributed this divergence to the nearly
例句.中文: 许多人把这一分歧归因于那条近 3,500 英里长的「野狗围栏」——这道屏障用于阻止牲畜进入，约 150 年前把澳大利亚分割成东南与西北两大区域。

例句.英文: Despite the marked divergence of such ballads as "The House Carpenter" from their antecedents in Britain, the balladry of the Appalachian South long figured as a proxy for the music naturalized there in the colonial era.
例句.中文: 尽管《木匠之家》这类歌谣已与其英国原型明显分化，阿巴拉契亚南部的歌谣传统长期被视为殖民时代本地化音乐的替代物。

义项: 名词 做苦工的人；苦役（the drudging lot of the laboring man）
动词 干苦活；做单调乏味的苦差（drudge at sth）
搭配说明: drudgery — n. 苦役；枯燥繁重的工作
drudge ≠ drudge on — 真题以 drudging 作形容词用
toil / grind — n. 辛劳 / n. 苦差——近义

例句.英文: … thinking of the drudging lot …
例句.中文: 司机在自己的操控间里烦躁不安，想着劳动者那苦役般的命。

义项: 形容词 以自我为中心的； egocentric axes 以说话者自身朝向为参照的轴
[辨析] egocentric（认知上以自我为参照）≠ egoistic / selfish（道德上自私）
搭配说明: egocentrism — n. 自我中心主义
allocentric — adj. 以他物 / 环境为参照的——真题对立概念
ego — n. 自我

例句.英文: Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions using spatial concepts and gestures, particularly along egocentric axes (i.e., relative to the orientation of the speaker): for instance, English speakers often refer to the front /back axis to describe events in time.
例句.中文: 此前研究发现，许多文化都倾向于用空间概念与手势来区分时间，尤其沿着以自我为参照的轴（即相对于说话者自身的朝向）：例如英语使用者把未来放在身前、把过去放在身后。

义项: 动词 喷出；弹出；射出（be ejected from）
动词 (引申义) 驱逐；逐出
搭配说明: ejection — n. 喷出；弹出
eject ≠ inject / reject / object — 同根 ject-（投掷）四词常混考
expel — v. 排出——近义，真题亦现

例句.英文: No other known heating mechanism on Jupiter could account for the formation of this anomalous structure, so one hypothesis considered was that it was ejected from the auroral region toward the equator.
例句.原书高亮: it was ejected from the auroral region
例句.中文: 木星上已知的其它加热机制都无法解释这一异常结构的形成，于是有假说认为：它是从极光区向赤道方向被喷射出来的。

例句.英文: FDM printers eject a modeling medium through a heated nozzle to build an object layer by layer..
例句.中文: FDM（熔融沉积成型）打印机通过加热喷嘴挤出成型介质，逐层堆建物体。

义项: 动词 （时间）流逝；过去（60 years had elapsed）
[辨析] elapse（时间过去，主语是时间）≠ lapse（失效、陷入；n. 间隔）
搭配说明: elapse ≠ elapsed time — 真题作 After 60 years had elapsed
elapsed — adj. 已过去的
pass / go by — v. 流逝——通用近义

例句.英文: After 60 years had elapsed, most of the seeds in those bottles stopped germinating, but Verbascum seeds have remained viable, including those from a bottle dug up in 2021 by Margaret Fleming, Matthew Chansler, and colleagues.
例句.中文: 六十年过去后，那些瓶子里的种子大多停止了萌发，但毛蕊花（Verbascum）种子仍保持活性，包括 Margaret Fleming、Matthew Chansler 及其同事2021年挖出的一瓶中的种子。

义项: 名词 私奔（an elopement）
[构词] elope（私奔）+ -ment
搭配说明: elope — v. 私奔
elopement ≠ elopement of — 真题作 the elopement of a society belle 上流社会名媛的私奔
elope ≠ escape — elope 特指「为结婚而私奔」

例句.英文: Even when they are sitting they must be on the move; they talk loud on modern topics—on flying machines or the elopement of a society belle.
例句.原书高亮: the elopement of a society belle
例句.中文: 即便坐着，她们也非动不可；她们高声谈论着时新话题——飞行器啦，某位社交名媛的私奔啦。

义项: 动词 移居国外；迁出（emigrate from）
[辨析] emigrate（从…迁出，接 from）≠ immigrate（迁入…，接 to）≠ migrate（迁徙）
搭配说明: emigrant / emigration — n. 移出者 / n. 移出
immigrant / immigration — n. 移入者 / n. 移入——真题同句对举
emigrate ≠ emigrated from — 真题取「从中国南方迁出」义

例句.英文: Many immigrants from north China, where Mandarin is the primary language, reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City's borough of Queens) while those who emigrated from south China, where many people speak Cantonese or Fuzhounese as a first language, tend to reside in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan.
例句.原书高亮: those who emigrated from south China
例句.中文: 许多来自以普通话为主的中国北方的移民住在法拉盛（纽约市皇后区的一部分），而那些从中国南方迁出的人——当地许多人以粤语或福州话为母语——则多住在曼哈顿区的唐人街。

例句.英文: It is about a group of men who emigrate from the Caribbean to Great Britain after World War II. .
例句.中文: 它讲述了一群人在二战后从加勒比地区移居英国的故事。

义项: 名词 魅力；令人陶醉之感（the enchantment of the woods）
名词 (引申义) 魔法；着魔（ fairy-tale enchantment）
搭配说明: enchant / enchanted — v. 使着迷 / adj. 被施了魔法的；陶醉的
enchantment ≠ enchanting — 后者是形容词「迷人的」
spell / allure — n. 魔力 / n. 吸引力——近义

例句.英文: … living enchantment, the emotional enchantment of the woods warmed by the sun of June.
例句.中文: 成千的童年回忆涌上心头，被这些乡野的气味唤醒；我走着，浑身浸透了那芬芳而鲜活的魔力——被六月的阳光晒暖的树林所予人的、情感上的魔力。

义项: 动词 （水、火、黑暗、头发）把…整个裹住、淹没
动词 be engulfed in flames / darkness；真题 practically engulfs her 是夸张写发量之厚

例句.英文: She has a thick curtain of long, coily hair that practically engulfs her.
例句.中文: 她那一头浓密卷曲的长发像厚帘子一样，简直把她整个人都裹了进去。

义项: 动词 招募；征募（enlist participants / volunteers）
动词 (引申义) 谋求（帮助、支持）：enlist the aid of
动词 入伍（enlist in the army）
搭配说明: enlistment — n. 入伍；招募
enlist ≠ enlist in — 真题取「招募受试者」义，不是「参军」
recruit — v. 招募——近义

例句.英文: The researchers tested this hypothesis by enlisting participants in an online game in which they had to correctly identify the meanings of ape gestures seen in videos.
例句.原书高亮: by enlisting participants in an online game
例句.中文: 研究者招募参与者玩一款在线游戏来检验这一假说：游戏中他们必须正确辨认视频里所见的类人猿手势的含义。

例句.英文: The institute enlisted botanist Janaki Ammal to breed a local variety of sugarcane..
例句.中文: 该研究所延请植物学家 Janaki Ammal 培育本地的甘蔗品种。

义项: 动词 使陷入（圈套、困境）；缠住（be ensnared in）
动词 (引申义) 诱使…就范；使难以脱身
搭配说明: snare — n. 陷阱；圈套——同根
ensnared — adj. 被困住的——真题以此形出现
entangle / trap — v. 缠住 / v. 困住——近义

例句.英文: Instead, she becomes ensnared in its corporate ideology.
例句.原书高亮: becomes ensnared in its corporate ideology
例句.中文: 相反，她反倒深陷于那套企业意识形态之中。

义项: 动词 设想；展望（envision a future / a company）
[辨析] envision（想象尚未存在之物）≠ envisage（英式，预见、设想）
搭配说明: vision / visionary — n. 愿景；视力 / n. 有远见者
envisioned — v. 过去式——真题以此形出现
envision ≠ envision that — 真题直接接名词宾语

例句.英文: Together, they envisioned a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals.
例句.中文: 他们共同设想出一家能够培育并展示黑人戏剧从业者作品的剧团。

义项: 名词 brand equity 品牌权益：品牌在消费者心中形成的价值，常表现为价格溢价
名词 金融语境：股东权益，与 debt 相对（equity financing）
名词 抽象义：公正无偏（equity in education）；与 equality 不同，强调按需补偿

例句.英文: Elena Markovic and colleagues examined 203 months of economic data to investigate whether line length mediates the effects of economic expansions and contractions on brand equity (the value, manifesting as a price premium, that a brand has in consumers’ minds due to its perceived quality and other associations).
例句.中文: 埃琳娜·马尔科维奇及其同事考察了 203 个月的经济数据，以研究句子长度是否中介经济扩张与收缩对品牌权益的影响——品牌权益是品牌因感知质量及其他联想而在消费者心中具有的价值，表现为价格溢价。

义项: 动词 （有意）避开；回避（eschew a tradition / convention）
[辨析] eschew 是「出于原则主动不采用」，比 avoid 更书面、更有立场
搭配说明: eschews / eschewed — v. 第三人称单数 / 过去式——真题两形皆现
eschew ≠ chew / eschewal — 后者是名词「回避」
shun / repudiate — v. 避开 / v. 拒斥——近义

例句.英文: Now seen as a mechanical precursor to the e-reader, Spanish educator and inventor Ángela Ruiz Robles’s Enciclopedia Mecánica eschewed pages in favor of three horizontal paper scrolls that could be easily swapped out to accommodate a range of subjects.
例句.中文: 如今被视为电子阅读器机械先驱的《Enciclopedia Mecánica》，出自西班牙教育家、发明家 Ángela Ruiz Robles 之手：它摒弃了书页，代之以三条可轻松更换的水平纸卷，以容纳不同学科的内容。

义项: 动词 表现出；显示出（性质、情感、风格）（evince an aesthetic / interest）
[辨析] evince（透露出内在特质）≠ evict（驱逐）≠ evoke（唤起）
搭配说明: evinced — v. 过去式——真题与 evince 同现
evidence / evident — n. 证据 / adj. 明显的——同根
display / manifest — v. 展现 / v. 表明——近义

例句.英文: After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in a broader architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the houses in Avenida Parque Mexico, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the house in Calle Liceo, which evince the aesthetics of traditional Mediterranean and Mexican styles.
例句.原书高亮: which evince the aesthetics of traditional Mediterranean
例句.中文: 20世纪30年代初赴美国与欧洲游历、并沉浸于更广阔的建筑话语之后，巴拉甘开始把源自功能主义与现代主义的原则纳入自己的作品，墨西哥大道公园一带的住宅即为一例：其未经装饰的几何形体，与他在瓜达拉哈拉的早期项目（如 Liceo 街的住宅）形成对照——后者明显体现着传统地中海与墨西哥风格的美学。

义项: 名词 精确（性）；严谨（biographical exactness）
[构词] exact + -ness
搭配说明: exact / exactly — adj. 精确的 / adv. 确切地
exactitude — n. 精确、严谨——正式近义词
exactness ≠ exactness of — 真题作 professors of biographical exactness 标榜传记精准性的专家

例句.英文: These defects are partly remediable, and even without an absolute violation of literal truth, although by methods rightfully interdicted to professors of biographical exactness.
例句.中文: 这些缺陷在一定程度上是可以补救的，而且即便未公然违背字面意义上的真实，其所采用的方法也是为那些标榜传记精准性的专家所正当禁止的。

义项: 动词 排出；喷出（material expelled during these events）
动词 (引申义) 驱逐；开除（be expelled from school）
搭配说明: expulsion — n. 排出；驱逐
expel ≠ compel / repel / dispel — 同根 pel-（推）四词常混考
eject — v. 喷出——近义，真题亦现

例句.英文: Material expelled during these events follows a narrow arc trajectory back to the Sun’s surface.
例句.中文: 这些事件中喷出的物质沿着一条狭窄的弧线轨迹落回太阳表面。

义项: 名词 （某种主张、风格的）代表人物；倡导者（an early exponent of hyperpop）
名词 指数；幂（同 power）
[辨析] exponent（代表人物）≠ opponent（对手）≠ proponent（支持者）
搭配说明: exponential — adj. 指数的；呈指数增长的
exponent ≠ exponent of — 真题取「早期代表」义，不是「指数」
proponent / practitioner — n. 拥护者 / n. 实践者——近义

例句.英文: The microgenre of electronic music known as hyperpop emerged in the 2010s, with American singer Dorian Electra as an early exponent.
例句.原书高亮: Dorian Electra as an early exponent
例句.中文: 被称为 hyperpop 的电子音乐微类型于2010年代兴起，美国歌手 Dorian Electra 是其早期代表人物之一。

例句.英文: The microgenre of electronic music known as hyperpop emerged in the 2010s, with Irish musician Maeve Kline as an early exponent.

义项: 副词 极其；精妙地（exquisitely responsive / crafted）
形容词 exquisite adj. 精美的；极敏感的
搭配说明: exquisite — adj. 精致的；细腻的
exquisitely ≠ exquisitely beautiful — 真题取「极其敏感」义，不是「精美」
exquisitely responsive to — 对…极其敏感——真题搭配

例句.英文: As ectothermic creatures exquisitely responsive to temperature and habitat changes, butterflies serve as nature’s early warning system.
例句.原书高亮: exquisitely responsive to temperature and habitat changes
例句.中文: 蝴蝶作为变温动物，对温度与栖息地变化极其敏感，因而充当着大自然的早期预警系统。

义项: 名词 图书与档案语境：力求还原原件的复制品（consult facsimile manuscripts）
名词 通信设备或传真件（send by facsimile）

例句.英文: One no longer widely read edition is the 1984 "critical and synoptic edition" edited by Hans Walter Gabler, which followed French and German editorial theories rather than editorial traditions of the United States and United Kingdom and which was later found to have introduced errors due to Gabler's choice to consult facsimile manuscripts rather than using only originals.
例句.原书高亮: to consult facsimile manuscripts rather than
例句.中文: 如今已不太流行的版本之一，是汉斯·瓦尔特·加布勒编辑的 1984 年校勘与对照版；它遵循法德两国的编辑理论，而非英美的编辑传统，后来被发现因加布勒选择参考摹本手稿而非仅使用原件而引入了错误。

义项: 名词 联邦主义者；（美国史）支持联邦宪法者
名词 the Federalist Papers《联邦党人文集》——真题固定译名
搭配说明: federal / federation — adj. 联邦的 / n. 联邦
anti-Federalist — n. 反联邦主义者——真题对举
federalist ≠ federal — 前者指人 / 派别，后者是形容词

例句.英文: The Federalist Papers are a collection of essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison and published pseudonymously in the New York Packet and other New York newspapers in 1787-88.
例句.原书高亮: The Federalist Papers are a collection of essays
例句.中文: 《联邦党人文集》是亚历山大·汉密尔顿、约翰·杰伊与詹姆斯·麦迪逊撰写的一组文章，1787至1788年间以笔名发表在《纽约邮报》及纽约其他报纸上。

义项: 名词 （悬挂的）花彩、彩饰（festoons of carnival）
动词 以花彩装饰（be festooned with）
搭配说明: festooned — adj. 挂满花彩的——真题以此形出现
festoon ≠ festival / festive — 形近义相关但词性不同
garland — n. 花环——近义

例句.英文: Bradford is driving through the countryside in Florida.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead.
例句.中文: 高大的水栎上的苔藓被一层银中带翠的润泽点亮，像狂欢节的彩饰，又像为悼亡而悬挂的丧礼装饰，垂挂下来。

义项: 动词 预示；为…埋下伏笔（foreshadow an event / outcome）
[构词] fore-（预先）+ shadow（影子）
搭配说明: foreshadowing — n. 伏笔——文学分析术语
foreshadow ≠ forestall — 后者是「预先阻止」，真题亦现
presage / herald — v. 预兆 / v. 预示——近义

例句.英文: This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.
例句.原书高亮: our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds
例句.中文: 这件事使我生出这样的感想：有时我们的想象会预先映出心头最挂念的东西，并把种种可能性带进现实的范围内。

例句.英文: This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.
例句.原书高亮: our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds

义项: 动词 预先阻止、防患于未然：在坏事发生之前就把它挡住
动词 (引申义) 抢先一步（做某事）以占得先机
[辨析] forestall ≠ prevent：forestall 强调「抢在前面」使某事无从发生；prevent 只强调阻止，不含抢先义
搭配说明: forestalling — n./v-ing 预先阻止——真题里最常以动名词形式出现
2024.03 A 卷 M2 Q6 — 正确选项 A：forestalling consideration of the full stylistic dimensions（阻碍对该时期诗歌完整风格维度的考察）

例句.英文: Although beneficial for forestalling loss of vascular function when leaf veins are blocked, reticulate (netlike)leaf-vein topologies in plants are thought to reduce efficiency in water and sugar transport and to increase vein construction costs relative to branched topologies.
例句.中文: 网状（网眼状）的叶脉拓扑虽然有助于在叶脉被阻塞时防止维管功能丧失，但人们认为它会降低水分与糖分运输的效率，并相对于分枝状拓扑提高叶脉的构建成本。

义项: 名词 艺术与文物语境：冒充真品的仿作（reveal forgeries）
名词 法律语境：伪造文书、签名或货币

例句.英文: Furthermore, nonvisible spectra can be used for chemical analysis to identify specific pigments and thus, in some cases, reveal forgeries: if, for example, titanium oxide—which wasn’t developed until the 20th century—is evident throughout the layers of a painting attributed to an 18th-century artist, that work can only be a forgery.
例句.中文: 此外，非可见光谱可用于化学分析，从而识别特定颜料，并在某些情况下揭示赝品：例如，若在署名 18 世纪艺术家的画作各层中明显检出二氧化钛——这种颜料直到 20 世纪才被开发出来——该作品就只能是赝品。

义项: 动词 （牲畜）吃草；放牧（livestock grazing / grazing livestock）
动词 (引申义) 擦过；轻触（graze the surface）
搭配说明: grazing — n./adj. 放牧；食草的——真题高频
graze ≠ glaze / grate — 形近异义
pasture / herbivory — n. 牧场 / n. 植食（作用）——真题同域词

例句.英文: Alessandro Filazzola et al. analyzed data on plant abundance from areas with livestock grazing (control sites) and without it (treatment sites) in Argentina and nineteen other countries and calculated the effect of excluding grazing livestock, where positive values indicated greater plant abundance in treatment sites relative to control sites.
例句.中文: Alessandro Filazzola 等人分析了阿根廷及其他十九个国家中有牲畜放牧区域（对照点）与无放牧区域（处理点）的植物丰度数据，并计算了排除放牧牲畜的效应：正值表示处理点的植物丰度高于对照点。

义项: 副词 严重地；极其（grossly absent / inadequate / overstated）
形容词 gross adj. 严重的；总的；粗俗的
搭配说明: gross — adj. 严重的；毛（重）的； gross domestic product 国内生产总值
grossly ≠ grossly exaggerate — 真题作 grossly absent 严重缺失
grossly ≠ gross — 副词与形容词勿混

例句.英文: MOMA claims the video presentations are only for games that would be impractical to display in a playable form, but video games are an inherently interactive medium, a feature that is grossly absent in a video-only presentation.
例句.原书高亮: a feature that is grossly absent
例句.中文: 现代艺术博物馆声称，影像展示只用于那些无法以可游玩形式呈现的游戏；可电子游戏本质上是一种交互媒介，而这一特征在纯影像的展示中严重缺失。

义项: 名词 居住；（人类）栖居（artifacts of human habitation）
名词 (引申义) 住所；聚居地
搭配说明: inhabit / habitable / habitat — v. 居住于 / adj. 可居住的 / n. 栖息地——同根真题全现
habitation ≠ habit — 后者是「习惯」
habitation ≠ habitation site — 考古学术语「居址」

例句.英文: Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur and her team examined a fox skeleton discovered in 1991 at an archaeological site alongside artifacts of human habitation (like spear points) in central Argentina.
例句.中文: 动物考古学家 Ophélie Lebrasseur 及其团队研究了1991年在阿根廷中部一处考古遗址发现的狐狸骨架，它与人类栖居的遗物（如矛尖）一同出土。

例句.英文: The researchers hypothesize that the site was a habitation site. .
例句.中文: 研究者推测该遗址曾是一处居住遗址。
